## 2025-05-15 - [Mass Assignment and Data Validation]
**Vulnerability:** Mass Assignment in `creators` table and missing input validation.
**Learning:** Shared schemas generated by `drizzle-zod` can inadvertently expose internal fields (like `isVerified`) to public API endpoints if not carefully omitted.
**Prevention:** Always define separate Zod schemas for public API inputs vs. internal operations. Use `omit` to explicitly exclude sensitive or system-managed fields. Implement robust field-level validation (regex, length limits) to prevent malformed data and DoS attacks.
